All four files already `#include <iostream>`, so no additional includes needed.

I found 4 direct callers of `AuthToken::validate` (via grep fallback, since `ast-tool callers` returned no results despite the symbol resolving fine) and added `std::cerr << "[auth] validating token\n";` immediately before each call:

- `src/auth/auth_service.cpp:14` — `AuthService::login`
- `src/web/auth_controller.cpp:13` — `AuthController::handleLogin`
- `src/web/auth_controller.cpp:26` — `AuthController::handleRefresh`
- `src/web/session_controller.cpp:12` — `SessionController::handle`

I excluded `AuthService::validate` (`auth_service.cpp:31`) — same method name, but it calls `cache_.get()`, not `AuthToken::validate`, so it's not a caller.
